mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let’s take a moment to bring everything together. First, remember—longing for joy isn’t a flaw. It’s something we all share. Think back to those childhood moments that filled you with wonder. Those memories still shape the deepest questions and hopes inside you. Imagination can be both a comfort and a distraction, but it’s also a hint that there’s something real out there, just beyond what we can see. And here’s something powerful—faith and intellect aren’t enemies. They can actually enrich each other, pushing us further than we’d ever go alone. Most of all, that ache of longing you sometimes feel? It isn’t a problem to fix. It’s a signpost pointing you somewhere meaningful. If you ever find yourself haunted by a longing you can’t quite put into words, know this: you’re not alone. This journey isn’t just about one person’s story—it’s about all of us. We each carry a hunger for meaning, a craving for beauty, and a hope that there’s more to life than what’s right in front of us. The path won’t always be straight. The questions might never be fully answered. But searching? That’s always worth it. So, let your longing guide you. Notice those moments that move you—the flashes of joy that break into your everyday life. Don’t shy away from your doubts, or from asking hard questions. They aren’t detours; they’re part of the journey. Trust that the ache you feel isn’t emptiness. It’s actually fullness, just waiting to be discovered. In searching for joy, you’re really searching for home. And that’s a journey worth taking, wherever it leads.
